{{Quote|Sergeant Harbon told me something about a time like this on Ferton.|A mercenary|<ref name="TRG1">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]&mdash;The Merc template</ref>}}
'''Ferton''' was an astronomical object<ref name="TRG1" /> located in the [[Ferton system/Legends|Ferton system]] of the [[Al'Nasrl sector/Legends|Al'Nasrl sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Harbon]], a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] with a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Company/Legends|company]], visited Ferton. The sergeant later told of the visit to [[Unidentified mercenary (Sergeant Harbon)|another member]] of the company.<ref name="TRG1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ferton was first mentioned in the [[1987]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|rulebook]] for the first edition of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TRG1" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Ferton [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body Ferton, within grid square T-13.<ref name="TEA" />
